name: Kago no Tori: The Caged Bird
original_name: カゴノトリ THE CAGED BIRD
source:
Main character decides to be a tutor after millionaire's request "please teach my daughters-in-law love". What kind of love will protagonist teach in this secluded mansion?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在百万富翁的请求“请教我的儿媳妇爱”之后，主角决定成为一名家庭教师。主角将在这座幽静的宅邸中传授怎样的爱情呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
